Cars, health, travel, home and personal accident. We explain what each cover does and does not do so you can decide with confidence.

Choose a cover

Each page sets out what to check before you buy.

  • MotorMotor insurance in Kenya starts with a legal minimum: third-party cover for injury or death to other people.View

  • HomeHome insurance protects your house and what is inside it.View
